data.title: Review concepts · Worked content example
data.instruction: Select a concept to explore its explanation. Select again to return to the front.

back.label: Why it matters
back.text: Keep the source requirements, evidence and reasoning together. Another reviewer should be able to identify what was checked and understand the basis of the decision.
A calculation may support one part of a submission without resolving every question. Identify what the evidence demonstrates and which matters still need clarification.

back.label: Example
back.text: A drawing omits the detail needed to check a connection. Record the missing information and request clarification instead of assuming the connection meets the requirement.
